body.statement: If \(\mathfrak G_{H,L}(\mathcal S)=\{G_0\}\), then the displayed refinement envelope equals the extrema of the single raw canonical polynomial program for \(G_0\). If, additionally, \(E_{G_0}^{\leftrightarrow}=\varnothing\), the program reduces to independent node-response factors for the known DAG.
body.justification: The new union must collapse to the established fixed-graph response-function analysis when lag uncertainty vanishes.
body.gap: This is a fidelity reduction to DuarteEtAl2024 rather than a separate novelty claim.
body.consumer: Existing fixed-graph Autobounds workflows become a special case and provide regression tests for the refinement compiler.
